subject: MediCorps: request for temporary backup purge accommodation and evidence plan
messages:
From: Jared Long <jared.long@medicorps.com>
To: david.kim@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@medicorps.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary backup purge accommodation + evidence plan

Hi David / Kimberly,

We have an upcoming compliance audit next week that requires us to confirm deletion activities for a subset of customer backups tied to our pilot program. The auditors asked for a short-term exemption window so we can reconcile a set of historical restores before those snapshots are garbage-collected.

Specifically we need:
- A short grace window (48-72 hours) on the scheduled backup purge for snapshots created between 2024-09-01 and 2024-12-31.
- Confirmation of what artifacts you can provide as evidence (purge logs, snapshots, KMS key rotation logs, and a signed statement about deletion completion).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can hold the snapshots for 72 hours, provide a sanitized list of object ids, and a copy of any purge runbook steps you follow? Attaching our preliminary checklist.

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Long
Sr. Legal Ops | MediCorps

Attachment: medi-retention-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: david.kim@redwoodinference.com <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Long <jared.long@medicorps.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary backup purge accommodation + evidence plan

Thanks Jared — appreciate the heads-up.

Short answer: we can support a temporary 72-hour hold on the purge schedule for that specific snapshot range, but I need to confirm a couple of operational details with Ops and Legal before I lock it in:
1) Which regions are in scope (we need to know if cross-border retention applies).
2) Whether you need object-level hashes or just snapshot identifiers.
3) If you require KMS/HSM audit logs stamped with your envelope id (that will need an approved access ticket).

Proposed immediate steps from our side:
- Kimberly will surface the retention/purge runbook excerpt and the purge execution log format.
- I will ask Ops to freeze the purge job for snapshots matching your filter and generate a candidate list.
- Marissa will coordinate a short evidence handoff (Drive link + signed confirmation).

Can you confirm region (US-only?) and whether MediCorps legal needs a notarized statement or a Redwood-signed deletion attestation?

David Kim
Sr. Security & Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: retention_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Jared Long <jared.long@medicorps.com>
To: david.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@medicorps.com>, it-admins@medicorps.com
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary backup purge accommodation + evidence plan

David — thanks. US-only is correct. For evidence we need:
- Snapshot IDs (path and creation timestamp)
- Purge job run logs showing object ids removed (or a signed manifest if you produce one)
- KMS operation logs for key access during the purge window (we only need the range of audit entries)
- A Redwood deletion attestation (simple one-paragraph signed statement indicating deletion actions completed and timestamps is fine)

Notarization not required, but the auditor prefers a Redwood-signed attestation on company letterhead.

If you can produce a sanitized manifest and a short attestation by end-of-day Friday (2026-05-01), that will let us keep the audit schedule.

Cheers,
Jared

Attachment: auditor-checklist-annotated.txt (txt)

From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Long <jared.long@medicorps.com>, david.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary backup purge accommodation + evidence plan

Jared — looping in the operational details below and the tentative timeline.

Operational plan (US snapshots, range 2024-09-01 -> 2024-12-31):
- 2026-05-01 11:00 PDT: Ops will set a 72-hour hold flag on purge job for matching snapshots.
- 2026-05-01 12:00 PDT: Generate sanitized manifest (snapshot_id, creation_ts) and purge-impact-digest.txt (summary of approximate tokens/objects).
- 2026-05-01 14:00 PDT: Produce KMS audit slice (range entries, redacted principal ids) and SOC2 summary extract (soc2-summary-2025.pdf).
- 2026-05-02 11:00 PDT: Redwood will provide a signed deletion attestation (PDF) that includes the post-purge verification steps.

Action items for MediCorps: please confirm acceptance of the sanitized manifest format (snapshot_id + creation_ts only) and whether you need principal ids redacted or replaced with stable pseudonyms.

Notes on evidence scope: we will not share object payloads. KMS logs will be redacted to remove internal operator usernames; we can provide exact timestamps and keyed event ids to map to your auditor requests.

Thanks — Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference

Attachment: purge-impact-digest.txt (txt)

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: david.kim@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

- Purge-impact-digest.txt attached to this thread

If the auditors need anything else, ping me and I will escalate to engineering.

Best,
Marissa Cole
